nodes.description: Boolean flag contract-level state variable that enables the deflationary/ gambling logic inside _getAmount.
Address of the ETH-X20 Uniswap liquidity pool; only transfers originating from this address can trigger rewards.
Monotonically increasing counter mixed into the keccak256 pseudo-random seed and incremented in _randModulus.
Owner-supplied random seed stored at startGame and used by _play and _randModulus.
Derived random seed stored at startGame and used by _play and _getRandomBurnedAmount.
Stores the win chance (100) set in startGame; written but never read by any logic path.
Ownable owner address used by the onlyOwner modifier guarding startGame.
ERC20 balances mapping mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20 total supply mutated by _mint and _burn.
MultiplierToken constructor: mints 10000e18 tokens to msg.sender and sets gameStarted to false.
onlyOwner function that initialises liquidityPool, seed1, seed2, chanceRate and flips gameStarted to true; game is irreversible.
Overridden ERC20 transfer that routes the amount through _getAmount before calling super.transfer.
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom that routes the amount through _getAmount before calling super.transferFrom.
Public view returning the gameStarted flag.
Private hook that, when the game is started, sends a reward then burns a pseudo-random portion of the transferred amount.
Private function that mints a 10x reward to the recipient when the sender is the liquidity pool and _play() wins.
Private function computing the 1%-10% burn amount from the seed-derived burn rate.
Public game function that compares two pseudo-random values derived from seed1 and seed2.
Private pseudo-random generator using nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty and msg.sender; increments nonce.
Caller-controlled address used as randomness entropy, as reward/burn subject and as owner during construction.
Miner-influenced 'now' value mixed into the pseudo-random seed in _randModulus.
Token minting (ERC20._mint) invoked by the constructor and by _sendReward; the reward mint is gated by predictable randomness.
Token burning (ERC20._burn) invoked by _getAmount on the sender's balance.
Weak pseudo-randomness construction (nonce, seeds, now, block.difficulty, msg.sender) that drives minting and burning.
startGame parameter holding the ETH-X20 liquidity pool address.
startGame parameter holding the owner-supplied random seed.
transfer recipient address forwarded to _getAmount.
transfer amount forwarded to _getAmount.
transferFrom sender address forwarded to _getAmount.
transferFrom recipient address forwarded to _getAmount.
transferFrom amount forwarded to _getAmount.
_getAmount recipient address passed into _sendReward.
_getAmount sender address passed into _sendReward and burned from.
_getAmount amount passed into _sendReward and reduced by the burn.
_sendReward amount multiplied by 10 and minted on a win.
_sendReward sender compared against liquidityPool.
_sendReward recipient that receives the minted reward.
_getRandomBurnedAmount amount from which the burn is computed.
_randModulus modulus applied to the keccak256 hash.
_randModulus seed mixed into the keccak256 hash.
Local burn amount computed in _getAmount and passed to _burn.
Local burn rate derived from seed2 in _getRandomBurnedAmount.
First random value computed in _play.
Second random value computed in _play.
Local random value returned by _randModulus.

edges.reason: startGame writes the liquidityPool state variable from the _liquidityPool parameter.
The _liquidityPool parameter value is stored into liquidityPool.
startGame stores _seed1 into the seed1 state variable.
The _seed1 parameter is assigned to seed1.
startGame derives and stores seed2 from _randModulus.
startGame writes the hardcoded chanceRate of 100.
startGame flips gameStarted to true, enabling the game logic.
startGame invokes _randModulus to generate seed2.
The owner supplied _seed1 value is used as the seed argument of _randModulus.
transfer delegates amount computation to _getAmount before transferring.
transferFrom delegates amount computation to _getAmount before transferring.
transfer recipient is forwarded as the recipient parameter of _getAmount.
transfer amount is forwarded as the amount parameter of _getAmount.
transferFrom sender is forwarded as the sender parameter of _getAmount.
transferFrom recipient is forwarded as the recipient parameter of _getAmount.
transferFrom amount is forwarded as the amount parameter of _getAmount.
_getAmount reads the gameStarted flag to decide whether the game logic runs.
_getAmount calls _sendReward to possibly mint a reward.
_getAmount calls _getRandomBurnedAmount to compute the burn.
_getAmount calls the ERC20 _burn operation on the sender balance.
_getAmount recipient flows into the _sendReward recipient parameter.
_getAmount sender flows into the _sendReward sender parameter.
_getAmount amount flows into the _sendReward amount parameter.
_getAmount assigns the computed burn amount to the local burnAmount.
The local burnAmount is the value destroyed by the burn operation.
_sendReward calls _play to decide whether the reward is granted.
_sendReward invokes the _mint token operation when the game is won.
_sendReward reads liquidityPool to decide if the caller is the pool.
The sender parameter is compared with the liquidityPool state variable.
The reward amount parameter (multiplied by 10) is the value minted.
The recipient parameter receives the freshly minted reward tokens.
_getRandomBurnedAmount calls _randModulus to obtain the burn rate randomness.
_getRandomBurnedAmount uses the seed2 state variable as randomness seed.
_getRandomBurnedAmount stores the derived burn rate in the local burnrate.
The transferred amount parameter is divided using the local burn rate to obtain the burn.
_play calls _randModulus twice to obtain its two comparison values.
_play reads seed1 as the seed of the first random draw.
_play reads seed2 as the seed of the second random draw.
_play stores the first random draw in local val1.
_play stores the second random draw in local val2.
_randModulus reads and increments the nonce state variable as entropy.
The modulus parameter controls the modulo applied to the hash.
The seed parameter is packed into the keccak256 entropy.
Caller-supplied msg.sender is mixed into the pseudo-random hash, allowing grinding of the result.
block.timestamp (now) is mixed into the pseudo-random hash, making the outcome miner-influenceable.
_randModulus assigns the computed hash modulo to the local rand.
_randModulus implements the weak pseudo-randomness generation used across the game.
msg.sender feeds directly into the weak randomness primitive.
block.timestamp feeds directly into the weak randomness primitive.
Predictable pseudo-random values determine the outcome returned by _play.
The predictable _play result controls whether _sendReward mints a 10x reward.
_randModulus returns the predictable values consumed by _play.
Weak randomness effectively gates an unbounded token mint, giving an attacker control over supply.
The constructor mints the initial 10000e18 supply.
msg.sender at construction time is the initial token recipient and owner.
The constructor initialises gameStarted to false.
The constructor execution path sets the Ownable _owner state variable.
msg.sender is used as the sender subject of the reward/burn logic in _getAmount.
